header.subtitle: Debt Management Mobile App
header.description: A mobile product concept for recording debts and following payment activity.

details.title: Project Details
details.body: Managing personal debt can be overwhelming and stressful. Users often struggle to keep track of multiple creditors, payment deadlines, and the overall progress of their repayment journey. The goal was to create a tool that simplifies this process while maintaining a sense of calm and control. We focused on a clean, minimalist interface that prioritizes clarity. By using a soft color palette and structured data visualization, we transformed complex financial information into an intuitive experience that encourages regular engagement and financial mindfulness.

perspective.title: 01 - PERSPECTIVE
perspective.quote: "Good interfaces begin with understanding the system behind them."
perspective.para1: My background in software engineering fundamentally shapes how I design. I don't just look at the visual layer; I deconstruct the underlying architecture. This allows me to create interfaces that are not only aesthetically pleasing but structurally sound and highly feasible for development teams to implement.
perspective.para2: I believe that true simplicity on the front-end is achieved by rigorous analysis on the back-end. By mastering system flows and requirements early on, I ensure that the user's path remains clear, logical, and undisturbed by technical complexities.
